summary: Temporary drone-only restricted area around RAF Lakenheath, Norfolk, with a 5 nautical mile radius, from surface to 1,200 ft above sea level.
text:
RESTRICTED AREA (TEMPORARY) INSTALLED FOR UAS ONLY (RAF
LAKENHEATH, NORFOLK) WI 5NM RADIUS OF PSN 522433.85N 0003339.64E.
PILOTS ARE FORBIDDEN TO FLY UAS WITHIN THE DESIGNATED AREA
WITHOUT THE PERMISSION OF EMERGENCY CONTROLLING AUTHORITY: RAF
LAKENHEATH ATC UNIT CTC TEL 01638-543610 OR EMAIL 
USAFE-UK.A3(AT)US.AF.MIL. RESTRICTION OF FLYING REGULATIONS MADE 
UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF AIR NAV ORDER 2016. AR-2026-10692/01.
